about_the_game:
A peculiar virus has taken root at the heart of an old computer system. As Little Bit, a newly-installed anti-virus, you are tasked with freeing the computer from the malware's clutches.

Each level in Tabula is comprised of a set of traversable computer windows. Rearrange and layer the windows to create a path, so that Little Bit can reach and activate the level's checkpoints. Activate all checkpoints to open a portal to the end of the level!

KEY FEATURES

  • Navigate a desktop made to feel like an old operating system

  • Arrange windows to create a path forward

  • Discover multiple unique solutions for each puzzle

  • Choose the order in which you complete puzzles

  • Unlock more folders with evolving complexity and new mechanics
